title: wc_static_assert2 on WC_HW_E \!= CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE is load-bearing
description: port.c:108-110 uses wc_static_assert2 to verify WC_HW_E and CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE are distinct. This guards the core return-code contract: returning WC_HW_E stops execution (no fallback) while CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE requests software fallback. If a future wolfSSL version accidentally assigned them the same value, hardware errors would silently fall through to software. The assert catches this at compile time. A contributor who removes this as 'defensive boilerplate' would break the safety guarantee.
